entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I... I need to return something. I ordered a helmet and it just arrived a few days ago. I feel awful about it.

I'm sorry to hear you're not completely satisfied. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a personal preference?

It's a preference, I guess. The color... it just looked so different on the website. Now that I have it here, it doesn't match my bike at all. It's silly, I know, but I've been a loyal customer for years and I really needed this to be perfect. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it.
Not silly at all. Getting the right gear that you love is part of the experience. And we appreciate your loyalty. Let me just confirm the item, you're calling about the VeloFit Aero-Tech helmet?
Yes, that's the one. I just... things are a bit tight right now and I was really hoping I could get my money back for it. I feel so guilty for even asking.

Please, don't feel guilty. Our goal is to make sure you're happy and, most importantly, safe. A proper helmet is the most important piece of safety gear, and if you're not going to wear it because you dislike the color, that's a problem we want to solve.

Since you received it just three days ago and it's a standard apparel item, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I'll just email you a pre-paid return shipping label right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. You're sure it's no trouble?

It is absolutely no trouble. The email is on its way to you now. Just print the label, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Wow. Thank you, Isaac. I was so worried. You've really helped me out today. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
